name: Earth and Planetary Science (GSGC / Doctoral), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Science — Department of Earth and Planetary Science

app_fee.value: Application fee for Graduate School of Science international tracks (GSGC and Special Selection for International Applicants) is JPY 10,000 paid by credit card (regular Japanese domestic entrance exams charge JPY 30,000).
app_fee.quote: Application Fee | 10,000 yen (Embassy Recommended Monbukagakusho Scholarship Recipients are exempted from paying the Application Fee)

also.quote: 10,000 yen (Monbukagakusho Scholarship recipients are exempted from paying the Application Fee.)

fee_waiver.value: Monbukagakusho (MEXT) Scholarship recipients are exempt from the JPY 10,000 application fee; no general need-based application fee waiver is offered.
fee_waiver.quote: 10,000 yen (Monbukagakusho Scholarship recipients are exempted from paying the Application Fee.)

deadline.value: December 22, 2026 (JST) for the Global Science Graduate Course (GSGC) 5-year PhD intake for October 2027 entry (window opens December 7, 2026; Special Selection for International Applicants self-financed/University MEXT round closed October 30, 2026).
deadline.quote: From December 7 to December 22, 2026(J.S.T): for applicants wishing to enroll in October 2027 (with or without a Student Visa)

gre_general.value: GRE score is required: applicants must submit either the GRE General Test or the GRE Subject Test in Physics or Mathematics, subject to prior confirmation with their prospective supervisor.
gre_general.quote: Regarding GRE scores in the application materials You must submit a score for either general, subject Physics or subject Mathematics.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology). Department accepts GRE Subject Physics or Mathematics as an alternative to the GRE General Test upon supervisor confirmation.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: Only native English speakers may request an advance TOEFL exemption from the Graduate School of Science; an English-medium degree from a non-native English country (such as India) does not waive TOEFL.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants whose native language is English may in some cases be exempted from submitting a TOEFL score, with the advance approval of the Graduate School of Science.

supervisor.value: Mandatory pre-application supervisor consultation and email proof of consent are required for GSGC and Special Selection applications.
supervisor.quote: Please contact your potential supervisor and submit the proof of your prior consultation such as a copy of correspondence e-mails.

funding.value: GSGC provides a monthly stipend of JPY 180,000 (for 2 years MSc + 3 years PhD) plus JSPS/MEXT/SPRING GX/WINGS/TA-RA opportunities across the Graduate School of Science (separate non-GSGC self-financed seats are unfunded at admission).
funding.quote: 10. GSGC Financial Assistance | We will provide a stipend of 180,000 yen per month while the student is on the course (for two years while they are in the Master's program, and for three years while they are in the Doctoral program).

entry_route.value: GSGC accepts Bachelor's graduates into an integrated 5-year Master's-to-Doctoral course, while the Special Selection for International Applicants admits both Master's and Doctoral applicants directly.
entry_route.quote: One who has been conferred a degree equivalent to that of a bachelor’s degree or is expected to be conferred one before entering the Master’s Program of the University of Tokyo | If you are currently enrolled in a master’s program or a doctoral program, have completed one such program, or have withdrawn after having fulfilled the requirements of one such program, please submit a transcript of the program.

notes: Spans Atmospheric & Oceanic Science, Space & Planetary Science, Earth & Planetary System Science, Solid Earth Science, and Geosphere & Biosphere Science. GSGC Master's applicants take a 20-minute online aptitude exam in mathematics, physics, or earth science.
